Time for money

Your paid step is an hour of you

A $75 session is a lovely way in, but every sale needs another hour of your time. Growth is capped by your calendar, not by how many women want your guidance.

Big jump

Free to 1:1 in one step

The download is a great first yes. After it, the next step asks a follower to book you personally, and most women want to learn your approach first.

Content treadmill

1,222 posts and counting

New eyes still depend on the next post. When you rest and receive, which is exactly what you teach, the flow of new women slows down too.

The women who love your content but aren't ready to book you today have nowhere to say a small yes, so most of them keep scrolling.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass on living your highest timeline, with a toolkit straight after checkout

You already have the audience, the voice and a free download women ask for. What's missing is one evergreen 60-minute class that teaches how you approach mindset and feminine living, offers a toolkit on the thank-you page, and invites the right women to apply on the replay. A small $17 ticket means everyone in the room chose to be there, and those seat sales help pay for Meta ads that bring new women to the class every day.
